resources.string: Places a movable tap target and floating Start/Stop controls over other apps, and performs taps only when you start them. It does not inspect screen content.
Configure repeat taps for the current screen.
Tap controls are enabled. The floating target is ready.
Tap controls are off. Enable the Clicksmith accessibility service to use the floating target.

Clicksmith uses Android\'s Accessibility Service to show a movable target and floating controls over other apps. When you press Start, it uses the target\'s screen position to send taps according to your settings. It does not read other apps\' screen content or send accessibility data to Clicksmith servers. Tap settings and target position are saved in app preferences and may be included in Android backups if device backup is enabled. Taps stop when the repeat limit is reached or you press Stop.
Review and accept the in-app disclosure before enabling tap controls.

After enabling the tap controls, drag the target onto the spot to tap. Use the floating Start/Stop buttons while another app is open. The accessibility service does not read other apps\' screen contents.
Enter valid numbers for the tap settings.
Android did not accept the tap gesture.
Movable tap target. Drag to position.
